flowContents.name: ReleaseVoteWatch
flowContents.comments: Release-vote automation (#76): watch dev@nifi.apache.org over IMAP, verify+build+smoke an RC as a capped k8s Job in release-builds, publish a recommendation. This flow NEVER casts a vote — the human replies from steven@sceneserver.net.

properties.Replacement Value: {"subject":"${vote.subject:escapeJson()}","leg":"${leg}","system":"${system}","gitRepo":"${gitRepo}","tag":"${rc.git.tag:escapeJson()}","commit":"${rc.git.commit:escapeJson()}","stagingUrl":"${rc.staging.url:escapeJson()}","jobName":"${k8s.job.name}","jobOutcome":"${job.outcome}","verifyOk":"${verify.ok}","buildOk":"${build.ok}","smokeOk":"${smoke.ok}","extensionCount":"${ext.count}","note":"${job.note:escapeJson()}","recommendation":"${verify.ok:equals('true'):and(${build.ok:equals('true')}):and(${smoke.ok:equals('true')}):ifElse('+1 suggested — all gates green','-1/0 suggested — a gate failed, read the evidence')}","caveat":"Built and smoke-tested on aarch64 (GB10); the RC reference binaries are x86 — weigh accordingly.","emittedBy":"ReleaseVoteWatch on spark-dd06 — recommendation only, never a vote"}

controllerServices.name: K8sApiTrust
controllerServices.comments: Trusts only the k3s cluster CA (#{k8s Cluster CA}).

ReleaseVoteWatch.name: ReleaseVoteWatch

parameters.name: IMAP Password
parameters.description: Sensitive — set via the API after upload from ~/.env SCENESERVER_IMAP_PASSWORD; never in this file.

parameters.name: IMAP Host
parameters.description: cPanel mail host (Dovecot); MX for sceneserver.net is itself.

parameters.name: k8s Dispatcher Token
parameters.description: Sensitive — release-build-dispatcher SA token (secret release-build-dispatcher-token, ns release-builds); set via the API after upload.

parameters.name: Core Maven Opts
parameters.description: MAVEN_OPTS for the core leg only; the API/NAR legs build fine on the default heap.

parameters.name: Core Maven Args
parameters.description: apache/nifi is the heavyweight reactor: parallel build, tests skipped so the run fits the poll window. The entrypoint stamps -DskipTests into the verdict note, so a recommendation always says tests were not run. Clear this to build with tests once the wall time is known to fit.

parameters.name: IMAP Folder
parameters.description: Folder ConsumeIMAP watches; switch if a server-side filter pre-sorts dev@ mail.

parameters.name: Build Image Maven
parameters.description: Stock arm64 image, pulled by containerd; entrypoint mounted from the maven-build-entrypoint ConfigMap.

parameters.name: IMAP User
parameters.description: The identity subscribed to dev@nifi.apache.org — the same identity the human votes from.

parameters.name: k8s Cluster CA
parameters.description: k3s cluster CA (public cert, valid to 2036) — pinned by the K8sApiTrust service.
